status: Design only; no production patch, build, solver, native decode, Git or SHA.
initial_mask_evidence: The single CPU r2 initial-frame audit compared all5000 native soil IDs. Eq68 including actual wall quadrature and self gives exactly the same100 surface IDs as current FSType2 and no FSType3. Soil-only+self gives296; both no-self definitions give5000. Retain current detector for this initial candidate without a new neighbor pass or tuned threshold; deformation-time equivalence is not established. See figures/upl_c08_fsmask_r1.check.json and _readable.png.
single_config: Propose only HydroMechFreeSeepage bool default0 in existing special/hydromechanics. Explicit true requires HydroMechDynamicSeepage and the narrow fresh constant-k elastic gravity container, HydroMechDrainage=0 and FixedGrid=0, InitNone and the already-verified static three-face geometry. No new event time, plasticity, variable-k, wall removal or general boundary entry. Existing HydroMechDrainage defaults/semantics and old literal routes remain unchanged.
actual_stage_order: CPU/GPU Single::ComputeStep_Sym: base force/rate -> Pre (PorePressPre allocated) -> internal half RunCellDivide -> half force/rate -> Cor (PorePressPre freed/NULL).

Single::Run outer loop: ComputeStep -> existing gauges -> outer RunCellDivide -> TimeStep+=dt -> optional SaveData. Outer RunCellDivide calls ApplyPorePressureBoundaries using completed geometry before all native saves, even when no save is scheduled.

RunCellDivide already tests !PorePressPrec/Preg to distinguish full-step regularization from predictor state. Reusing this existing integration lifetime avoids a new stage member or changing all callers. InitNone initial p0=0 makes initial full-state projection idempotent. Gauge API currently receives position/velocity/stress, not pore pressure; it precedes the outer projection and must not later be advertised as an already-projected pore observer without revisiting order.

explicit_projection_choice.predictor: Do NOT clip p in Pre, the half RunCellDivide, or the half force entry. Predictor surface pressure may be temporarily positive. It participates in the declared midpoint evaluation; only finite/valid-state gates apply. This retains completed-step-only ponding rather than silently creating a two-stage projected scheme.
explicit_projection_choice.corrector: Compute p_full=p_old+dt*rate_half without clipping against stale half FSType. At outer RunCellDivide, recompute current geometry/state/FS/C, then only when the existing PorePressPre pointer is NULL clamp native fluid FSType2/3 with p>0 to float0. Leave p<=0 and rate history unchanged. Do not zero rate, J or theta. No dependence on output cadence or SaveData.
explicit_projection_choice.wall_refresh: For an unambiguous same-stage postcondition, after completed positive-only native projection call existing ComputeDynamicPoreWallStateCpu/Gpu once. It refreshes pressure ghosts from the constrained native state; geometry, J and C are unchanged by the pressure-only projection, so no second FS/C pass is needed. This is one additional existing local MLS pass in the explicitly enabled completed-step branch, not a new field/kernel neighbor formulation. Later main-force/SaveData tracking already refreshes wall state, but relying only on that would leave ApplyPorePressureBoundaries return temporarily stale; choose the immediate postcondition explicitly. Do not replace actual wall ghost pressure with zero or clamp fixed-wall samples.

rate_candidate_still_requires_zero_step_: Let gp be current corrected gradp, lx the existing first-moment defect, da existing corrected div(Ace), and b=gp+rho_w*Ace_i. Current constant-k L is exactly [lp+rho_w*Ace_i.dot(lx)+rho_w*da]-b.dot(lx). For explicitly open native surface, the candidate raw hydraulic form is the bracketed term; interior keeps the original expression literally. Compression -theta remains. This is an algebraically motivated dynamic extension, NOT automatically proved by Lian2021 Eq72 static-head formula. It must pass hydrostatic gp=rho_w*g,Ace=-g zero-response, affine nonzero b and nonconstant-Ace independent references before use. Merely deleting -gp.dot(lx) would fail hydrostatics. No variable-k chain or temporary closedfs substitution is enabled by this new policy.
minimal_source_locations: JSph.h/.cpp: one member, default/read/log, mutual-exclusion and narrow container predicate validation. Keep default Drainage=1; a new free-seepage input must explicitly select Drainage0. XML guide/case notes must explain completed-only projection and initially limited scope.

JSphCpu.cpp: ApplyPorePressureBoundaries completed branch and ComputeDynamicPorePressureRateCpuT final L selection. Existing ApplyFreeSurfacePorePressure and Pre/Cor pore updates already see legacyDrainage0, so their literal old logic needs no new clipping branch.

JSphGpu.cpp + JSphGpu_ker.h/.cu: completed ApplyPorePressureBoundaries invokes the existing projection wrapper with one optional final ponding flag; kernel p>0 branch must not touch rate. Actual dynamic-rate wrapper/kernel receives the separate policy. Append defaults for old direct-component caller compatibility. Existing predictor/corrector update kernels and Single::Run/ComputeStep need no changes for the stated rule.
minimum_checks: First zero-step operator/head proof and positive/zero/negative projection at actual full versus predictor pointer lifetimes, including no wall/interior mutation and immediate wall refresh. Then unchanged default/OFF and legacy fixed-zero regression. Only after these, one short real CPU/GPU constant-k container startup with native saved clocks and force/pressure/ledger safety; no new half chain, physical equilibrium or collapse admission. Initial mask evidence alone is not hydraulic-boundary acceptance.
